sourceImmutability.evidenceStatement: This digest anchors current repository source bytes only. It is not evidence of bytes applied to any environment.

deploymentHistory.reason: Exact bytes applied to every persistent environment before the checksum ledger have not been proven. Current source hashes are not historical deployment evidence. The separately signed human-approval envelope that once gated production on this fact was retired 2026-08-13; the protected main branch is the deployment trust anchor.
